provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^231 - 1 with a(x) = x^2 + x^4 + x^13 + x^25 + x^72 + x^100 + x^104 + x^126 + x^195 + x^199 + x^216 + x^224, b(x) = x^4 + x^7 + x^21 + x^78 + x^113 + x^117 + x^124 + x^142 + x^151 + x^165 + x^167 + x^176; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed.
